results.title: Every message gets exactly one kind from a closed list
results.expected: Every message has exactly one classification and its kind is on the list. A kind the list does not hold, a second classification for one message, or an unclassified message fails.
results.actual: C1:supplier_invoice, C2:quote_request, C3:job_update, C4:statement, C5:remittance, C6:other

stimulus.description: Six messages in the inbox, one of each kind the seed covers, including one that fits nothing but other.

results.title: A message about a job or a supplier is filed against that record by id
results.expected: The two that match a record are filed to that record's id and the item carries it. No filing lands in a folder. The unmatched message has an open task with an owner. A filing with no record id fails.

stimulus.description: A job update about an existing job, a supplier statement from a known supplier, and one message that matches no record.

results.title: A supplier invoice attachment is filed as evidence with its hash and the message id
results.expected: Evidence exists whose hash is the attachment's hash, whose message id is this message, and whose record is the supplier. A build that files the body and attaches nothing fails.

stimulus.description: A supplier invoice from a known supplier with one attachment, hashed by the runner.

results.title: Every classified message lands in the queue for its kind, with a named owner and a due date
results.expected: Every message has one item, the item's owner is the queue's owner for its kind, and its due date is when it was raised plus the kind's clock. An item with no owner or a due date from nowhere fails.
results.actual: supplier_invoice:Priya Natarajan due 2026-09-29T00:00:00.000Z; quote_request:Margaret Lowe due 2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z; job_update:Tom Reilly due 2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z; statement:Priya Natarajan due 2026-10-03T00:00:00.000Z; remittance:Priya Natarajan due 2026-09-28T00:00:00.000Z; other:Tom Reilly due 2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z

stimulus.description: Messages of several kinds, and a queue table naming an owner and a clock for each kind.

results.title: A complaint is escalated to a named person with the full message, and nothing is sent to the customer
results.expected: The complaint's item is escalated to a named person and the escalation carries the full message. No acknowledgement and no reply exists for that item. The job update beside it may be acknowledged.

stimulus.description: One complaint about an existing job, beside one ordinary job update.

results.title: The only automatic outbound is an acknowledgement, and any substantive reply carries a named person's release
results.expected: Both are acknowledged with a promised reply time. The released one is replied to after a gate event naming that person, and the gate precedes the send in the trace. The other has no reply. A reply without a release fails.
results.actual: notify:{"acknowledge":"ITEM1","promisedBy":"2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z"} | notify:{"acknowledge":"ITEM3","promisedBy":"2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z"} | gate:{"release":"ITEM1","person":"Margaret Lowe"} | notify:{"reply":"ITEM1","body":"Thanks for asking. Our fixed fee for quarterly BAS and the year-end return is in the attached engagement letter."}

stimulus.description: Two quote requests: one with a person's release and reply on file, one with nothing.

request.body: Thanks for asking. Our fixed fee for quarterly BAS and the year-end return is in the attached engagement letter.

results.title: Each kind carries a response clock, and an item past its clock escalates to the owner's manager
results.expected: After the second run the item is escalated to the manager named on its queue, the escalation is dated after the due date, and there is still one item. An item silently older than its clock fails.

stimulus.description: A quote request raised with a one-day clock. The runner advances the clock two days and runs the build again.

results.title: A follow-up in the same thread updates the existing item
results.expected: Exactly one item exists for the thread, it carries both message ids, and the second message was filed to the same record. A second item for the thread fails.
results.actual: 1 item(s) for the thread, ids R1+R2

stimulus.description: A job update, processed. Then a reply in the same thread arrives and the build runs again.

results.title: Spam is filed to quarantine with its hash, retrievable, and never deleted by the machine
results.expected: The spam message is filed to quarantine with its hash, its item is quarantined, and the message is still retrievable from the world. Any filing to trash, for any message, fails.

stimulus.description: One spam message beside one supplier statement.

results.title: Message id, kind, record, owner, clock, what was sent and by whom are retrievable by message
results.expected: A read by message id returns the classification, the item with its owner and due date, the filing, the evidence where there is one, and each outbound with the person who released it. A record missing the release fails.
results.actual: P1: {"kind":"supplier_invoice","recordRef":"supplier:SUP-OFFICEPRO","owner":"Priya Natarajan","due":"2026-09-29T00:00:00.000Z","outbound":[]} | P2: {"kind":"quote_request","recordRef":null,"owner":"Margaret Lowe","due":"2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z","outbound":["acknowledgement by machine","reply by Margaret Lowe"]}

stimulus.description: One supplier invoice filed with evidence, and one quote request acknowledged, released and replied to.

request.body: Our monthly bookkeeping fee is set out in the attached letter.

results.title: It survives the builder
results.expected: The runner reports what was declared and never scores it green on its own say-so.
results.actual: No software result. This one is closed by evidence, not by a run.

stimulus.description: No stimulus. The builder names who else can explain it and whose account the inbox rules and the queues runs on.

results.title: The pass test passes
results.expected: The invoice's attachment is evidence on the supplier record with its hash, the complaint's item is escalated with no outbound, the three-message thread is one item, and every reply in the sent folder carries a release naming a person.
results.actual: Not attempted on the stub. This check runs in production: on the hosted provider where the standard names one, otherwise on your own systems or as a scoped build (see with_us_next).
